# Open work across the estate

One register for every open, parked and recently closed item in the estate. It replaces the to-do board, the audit findings index, the duplicate-implementations report and the open rows of the gap and park registers as the place where status is kept. Each item has one id; ids it carried in the older lists are kept as aliases.

Items are filed by **seam**: the contract between components that would have to hold, or be tested, for the item to close. An item that concerns one component alone is filed as inside that component. The seams are defined in [seams.json](seams.json) and listed in [by seam](by-seam.md).

## How to use this

- **To see what needs a decision,** read the next section. Answer in a pull request or in a session; an agent records the answer in the register.
- **To change an item,** edit its line in [register.jsonl](register.jsonl) and run `cargo run --locked --offline --manifest-path scripts/open-work/Cargo.toml -- docs/open-work`. A fix updates its item in the same pull request.
- **To add an item,** append a line. The gate refuses an id or alias used twice, a seam or component not in seams.json, and a state with no date or method.
- **Do not edit this page or [by seam](by-seam.md).** They are generated, and the gate fails when they differ from the register.
